author: Junr
body:
When you use /staff, it tells online staff members, but it doesn't show if they are AFK. It would be nice if you added an AFK tag next to their name when they go afk, so players know when they go afk. I suggested it, because they get spammed when they aren't there and there is a lot of complains when players don't see a staff member on when there is a lot of rule breakers.

Thanks,
Junr

title: Suggestion: /staff

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Honestly I think the feature that kicks you after being afk for a certain amount of time should be put back into place. Like I love being able to stay afk and not get kicked but on a regular members POV having a staff member go afk and not get kicked just causes major confusion, especially if he/she is the only one and would rather take the flaw of getting kicked to have it implemented for staff as well. 
The AFK feature could be a good thing but would clutter up the chat even more with the "AFK" before or after their name since their tag rank is already shown unless there is a virtual "AFK" section like the "DTM" section, "TDM" sections, e.t.c..
I agree with this 100% :)

replies.author: ALM
replies.body: Showing AFK staff defeats the purpose of .staff. If a hacker comes on, and does /staff, they will be less likely to hack when they see staff on. Now, if staff were denoted with some kind of identifier when AFK, the hacker would realize that the staff that are on are actually AFK, and will cheat as they please.
